This device is a small repeater or AP with one ethernet port :which can be plugged in directly into a mains socket. This OEM product page is [[Winstars]] [http://www.win-star.com/en_us/product/WS_WN581N2.html WS-WN581N2].
Many branded devices are clones of this like: * [https://www.wavlink.com/en_us/product/WL-WN581N2.html Wavlink WL-WN581N2] • [[Wavlink WL-WN581N2]] * [https://www.conrad.de/de/p/renkforce-rf-wr-n300mini-wlan-repeater-300-mbit-s-2-4-ghz-repeater-access-point-1574526.html Renkforce RF-WR-N300MINI]
Based on the [[MediaTek]] MT7628KN WiSoC (2T2R 2.4GHz) :with 2MB [[GigaDevice]] GD25Q16CSIG3 (SPI) flash.
